shared_or_similar_visual_information: A colored region delimited by the intersecting contours of two circles. On the left, use the tan lens containing 9 and 10. On the right, use the pink Climate Change crescent marked 55, outside the other circle.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The lens lists the elements belonging to both A and B. Right image: The region represents respondents concerned about Climate Change only.
Rationales: The lens is inside both circle boundaries, so it requires both memberships. The crescent lies inside only one circle and excludes the shared members.
